Method of Attack: Collects excessive user data beyond needed functionality
Launches without user interaction to steal sensitive data

Exfiltrates users' contact list, connected email accounts, social networks, pictures, audio, video, real-time location, mobile country code, network provider name, SIM network code, OS version, device brand and model
Hides home screen icons to evade detection and removal
Abuses permissions to restart device and launch in background
Likely uses emulators or install farms to bloat popularity
Attack Vector: Malicious file management apps installed from Google Play
Indicators of Compromise: Excessive data collection without user consent
Removed from Google Play as of 2023-07-06
